title: Dancing in Cosmic Swirls
description: A luminous ballerina spins at the center of swirling concentric circles on a reflective surface, her form glowing with yellow and purple light trails. In the background, a glowing rooster appears in the upper left, a brown dog stands to the left, and large crystalline snowflake structures float nearby under a dreamy blue sky with pastel balloons.
prompt: A luminous ballerina spinning gracefully in the center of swirling concentric energy rings on a reflective floor, her body trails glowing yellow and purple light. A translucent glowing rooster floats in the upper left sky, a brown dog stands watching on the left, and a large crystalline snowflake sparkles nearby. Pastel balloons drift in a bright blue dreamy sky filled with soft clouds and sparkling particles, whimsical fantasy style, ethereal glowing atmosphere.
